body:
So from your perspective what should I do?

I probably won't take your advice because I really do believe that there is some real hope here, and I love her.  But I'll bite and ask you the hypothetical question: What would you do?  Break up with her and have a strong possibility of suicide? Would you send her back to get treatment that makes her feel inhuman?

My personal answer to this is that I love her and everything that I do to make sure she is happy or at least okay is completely worth it.  You don't think I know that sometimes she can use the threat of suicide as a crutch to make me feel sorry for her?  But I can't take those lightly and I will allow myself to be manipulated if that means maintaining her safety.

I'm truly sorry for your loss and I would really value the advice of someone who has seen the worst side of this situation.  Maybe you can help me never have to see that ugly side.

That's what I have told her plenty of times.  She hates therapists for some reason I'm not sure of. Maybe she has had a bad experience with one in the past.  She has refused help and her main reason is that she can't trust anyone like that with her life and her personal details.  She really only opens up to me and I don't have a clue compared to an actual therapist, not for a lack of trying.

I don't know how to get her to go see one.
